game.label: Your copy of Godzilla: Save the Earth for the original Xbox (USA/Europe): its disc image (.iso or .xiso.iso), or its extracted folder with default.xbe.

prepare.label: Unpacking your disc and adding the menu extras

exit_codes.1: The game couldn't find default.xbe in your copy. Pick your copy again on the game's page.
exit_codes.2: That copy can't be read, or isn't Godzilla: Save the Earth for Xbox. Pick its disc image or folder again.
exit_codes.3: Your copy's default.xbe is a different version from the one this build was made from. It needs the USA/Europe release.
exit_codes.4: The game couldn't write next to its program. Unpacking the disc needs about 1 GB free in the game's folder.

settings.label: Aspect ratio
settings.help: Widescreen shows more of each side of the city, with the HUD kept in the corners. 4:3 is the console's picture.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: 60 is the console's rate. Game speed stays real time at every rate; 120 and 144 need a fast PC and a screen that shows them.

settings.label: Game speed
settings.help: Turbo runs the whole game 20% faster (monsters, effects and the fight clock). System Link matches always run at normal speed.

settings.label: Button icons
settings.help: The buttons shown in menus and tips. The first start picks the controller that is plugged in.

settings.label: Tournament mode
settings.help: Every monster and city unlocked, whatever your profile has earned. Online play turns it on for both players.

settings.label: Online (System Link)
settings.help: Multi-Player > System Link over your network. Over the internet, put the other player's IP address after online_peer= in gz_settings.ini; UDP ports 1000-1002 must be open.

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Automatic is full screen in Big Picture mode and a window on the desktop. Full screen is borderless, with the picture letterboxed.

settings.label: Window size
settings.help: The size of the game's window when it isn't full screen.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at, in steps of the console's 640 x 480. Match the window is sharp at any size.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Sharp keeps streets and buildings crisp at shallow angles and costs next to nothing.

settings.label: Movies
settings.help: The intro, story and credits movies. Playing them needs ffmpeg.exe in the game's folder or on PATH; without it they are skipped.

settings.label: Face buttons
settings.help: Swapped puts the game's A on the right face button and B on the bottom one, as on Nintendo pads. Every button can be changed in gz_controls.ini.

settings.label: Stick deadzone
settings.help: How far the sticks move before the game sees it, in percent. Raise it if your monster drifts on its own.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: Your profile and the game's own save files.

actions.label: Controller layout
actions.help: gz_controls.ini, where every button and both sticks can be changed.

actions.label: Screenshots
actions.help: Pictures taken with F12 in game.

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Shaders the game has built, so later starts don't stutter. Clearing only helps if graphics look wrong after an update.
